title: Chapter 623
text:
Any class would meet its nemesis.

The Esper class was the most unique. It could be countered by the other four classes, but it could also be countered by the random nature of Esper Ability Awakening.

Among the five Super classes, the advantages and disadvantages of Esper Abilities were equally obvious. Combat power depended on the different Esper Abilities, and the Class Knowledge Tree was also a jack of all trades. It increased the strength, control, range, usage, and so on.

The advantages were obvious. Esper Abilities could shine in a single aspect, but their weaknesses were equally obvious. They lacked abilities in other aspects, and their abilities had their own limitations.

For example, teleportation. Its weakness was naturally its defense. For example, high-speed regeneration and immortality, it clearly did not have much combat power. For example, prophecy.

Of course, these were all relatively extreme Esper Abilities, but it also showed that the advantages and disadvantages of Esper Abilities were prominent. To the players, obtaining a special Esper Ability greatly increased the fun in the game, and there were countless tycoons who spent money to buy Esper Ability Gene Awakening Potions.

Other than those lucky tycoons, some African chiefs and tycoons would constantly use Gene Awakening Potions in order to obtain an Esper Ability that they liked until they succeeded.

In the team battles of the Pro League, the rational allocation of personnel to deal with the opponent's Esper was also a strategic point.

Espers with Magnetic Field Metal Manipulation would naturally not be able to fight against Pugilists and Mages. However, it happened to be the nemesis of Mechanics, and Han Xiao would be lying if he said that he was not troubled.

Although he was a Mechanic and also had magnetic energy, compared to an enemy with awakened Esper Genes, the strength of his magnetic field manipulation ability was worlds apart.

The use of Mechanical Force was more to strengthen machinery, and magnetic field manipulation was only an additional ability. At most, it would hinder the opponent's Esper Ability. If he wanted to completely neutralize the opponent's magnetic field, he would have to rely on special machinery.

When they exchanged blows, Han Xiao looked at the combat information and knew that the opponent was called Shana. Her level was actually a question mark. He was already level 170, and even if Shana was not A +, she was not far from it. The huge difference in strength was very difficult to make up for.

"Risda, get away from the battlefield first!"

Han Xiao dodged the metal fragments and ordered Risda. If the Blacklight Stealth was destroyed, he would suffer a huge loss.

The Blacklight Stealth quickly rose into the air and was about to leave the battlefield. Seeing this, Shana did not care. She stretched out her hand and aimed at the Blacklight Stealth, preparing to crush Han Xiao's spaceship like how she had crushed the other spaceships.

Bang!

In the next moment, a white figure crashed into Shana's magnetic field shield like a meteor with a lightning-like tail of flame behind it. Shockwaves spread out as it broke through the sound barrier and crashed into Shana's magnetic field shield.

The invisible magnetic field caved in and bounced the white figure away as if it was elastic. Shana was not injured, but she was sent flying for a short distance by the recoil. She quickly controlled the metal on her body to stabilize herself in the air. She looked down at the white figure expressionlessly.

Han Xiao had changed into a bone-white mecha. It was the Void Dragon mecha that had retired to the second line.

"This person's ability restrains me, so I can only take out non-metallic weapons to face the enemy …" Han Xiao thought to himself.

The metal content of the Void Dragon mechanical suit was very small. Although its attributes could not keep up with a Calamity Grade, it was not as restrained as the Berserk Ape and could still be used.

Most of his machines were made of alloy materials, and non-metallic machines probably only accounted for about 10% of the total.

Many machines had strict requirements for the properties of the materials used. High-density non-metallic materials that could replace all kinds of alloys were difficult to synthesize. Based on the difference in materials, the properties of the machines would also fluctuate. Before encountering an enemy that could control metal, alloys were naturally the most cost-effective.

If he did not use galactic-grade alloys, carbon nanotubes would be a good choice. However, his previous opponent was Ashes …

Even if he wanted to build machines to counter his opponent, it would be after the battle. At this time, Han Xiao's Army Style and large number of main battle machines could not be used unless he did not care about the losses.

The way he saw it, the current situation was far from that stage.

"Let's test her limits first."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

Taking advantage of the time when Shana was distracted, Risda accelerated and successfully left the battlefield, avoiding the fate of being torn apart into scrap metal.

All the remaining spaceships were crushed into pieces by Shana, forming a metal storm that swept toward Han Xiao.

Other than Han Xiao and the other two Calamity Grade Supers, everyone else was killed. Some of the Grade C warriors wearing metal battle suits were directly sent to their deaths by the sandstorm.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

Han Xiao shuttled through the metal storm, dodging nimbly. His palm cannon fired continuously at Shana, but the Void Jet Spray could not penetrate Shana's magnetic field shield. Its defense was amazing.

At this time, Jayne gritted his teeth and roared.

"Hah!"

His shirt was torn apart, revealing his muscular body. His body vibrated at a high frequency, and the surrounding air vibrated. The vibrating force was transmitted to the ground under his feet, and the surface area of the ground cracked rapidly.

Immediately after, Jayne slapped his palm toward Shana, who was in midair.

Dong!

A huge formless vibration wave went straight for Shana. Wherever it passed, the air would distort and form an oval shape. The momentum was shocking.

Shana frowned slightly and moved horizontally in midair, quickly dodging.

Only Jayne was not restrained. Han Xiao looked over and saw that Jayne was bare-chested, and his chest hair was trembling freely.

What a mouthful of burly man's chest hair!

At this time, a sudden mission popped up on the interface.

You have triggered Hidden Grade A Chain Mission, [Prey]!

Mission Introduction: You are the prey of a terrifying organization. They will hunt you down again and again until they succeed. Do not have any hope of escaping. Their background is beyond your imagination. You have no other choice. Try your best to struggle. You may still have a glimmer of hope …

First Round: Defeat Shana

Reward: 3,700 Experience and draw one of Shana's abilities or talents.

"Terrifying organization? Interesting. "

Han Xiao looked at the mission introduction and had a thought.

He remembered the storyline in his previous life, but Shana did not seem to be related to any organization in his memory. It seemed like it might be a hidden organization that the players had not come into contact with in his previous life. Their targets were all famous Grade A Supers, so it was indeed difficult for them to interact with the players.

This thought flashed through his mind. He was still in the middle of the battle, and the three of them were surrounding Shana.

Jayne and Gadeli were both Calamity Grade Supers, so they could cooperate with Han Xiao without the need for words.

Since there were helpers, Han Xiao would naturally make use of them. He took up the responsibility of fighting head-on and attacked Shana's magnetic field shield time and time again. Jayne acted as the main attacker, and the threat of his vibration attacks forced Shana to dodge continuously. As for Gadeli, he did not approach after being sent flying and ran dozens of kilometers away. The strength of a Gunner Master was long-range attacks, so he attacked crazily from afar.

A range of dozens of kilometers was nothing to a Grade A Gunner Master, and his accuracy was still accurate. As long as the power was not reduced, he could shoot even further. His nickname 'Hundred Turn Cannon' was a reference to his attack frequency. The continuous long-range attacks made Shana feel very uncomfortable. She wanted to target Gadeli, but she was held back by Han Xiao.

Boom boom boom!

The few of them were in a chaotic battle. The attacks of Calamity Grade Supers were powerful, and the ground cracked and exploded.

Again and again.

Both parties were in a stalemate, and Shana was a little frustrated.

Bredt, who had been beaten up by Han Xiao and the others, was actually a member of an intelligence organization under Bloodshed Land. He had received Klent's orders to come to Colton to gather information. Coincidentally, Shana's organization had a special relationship with Klent. After capturing Kernid, she happened to be in this area. After Bredt was attacked, the intelligence organization that he was in had notified Shana, who was nearby, to ask for help.

However, Shana had arrived late, but because of that, she had discovered Black Star's tracks. Thus, she changed her target and directly attacked Black Star. The way she saw it, Black Star had sent himself to her, so she did not have to go to the Garton Star System to deal with him.

Shana had come with absolute confidence to deal with Black Star, but she did not expect to be in a tough battle.

In Bredt's intelligence, there was no information about Jayne and Gadeli. Because Han Xiao had controlled the Third Generation Ship Destroyer to quickly finish off the fleet, the two of them had no choice but to take action. Now, they had become unexpected reinforcements.

"Game over."

Shana did not want to waste any more time. She suddenly pointed her hands at the ground and fully activated her Esper Ability.

Rumble!

The ground shook violently.

The next moment, something shocking happened!

Within a radius of tens of kilometers, holes suddenly collapsed. Almost a hundred giant snakes made of metal particles broke through the ground. They were more than ten meters thick and had an endless length.

The ground was instantly riddled with holes!

Earth Dragon Flip!

The next second, hundreds of giant metal snakes rose into the air and crashed toward the three of them.

"Triggering the planet's magnetic field and using the metal elements underground … What a terrifying ability."

Han Xiao immediately felt troubled. An Esper with the Magnetic Field Metal Control Ability definitely needed metal to unleash their strength. If it was just those spaceship fragments, Shana's threat would not be high. However, her ability was strong enough to trigger the planet's magnetic field, which was equivalent to the entire planet being Shana's arsenal.

This was a well-deserved natural disaster!

Gadeli's eyes widened. He quickly tried to distance himself, but he was caught up by two giant metal snakes. The giant metal snakes swallowed Gadeli whole. Then, the two giant snakes merged and turned into a metal sphere with a diameter of a few hundred meters. It crashed heavily onto the ground.

Ka ka ka!

The sphere kept squeezing and increasing its density, trapping Gadeli inside. This was Shana's tried and tested move.

Jayne panicked. She slammed her fists on the ground. Clearly, she had used some kind of ability. A shockwave spread out.

Boom!

The frequency of the shockwave triggered a chain reaction of stress. The vibration of the ground suddenly increased, and a terrifying earthquake swept through the area. Countless giant metal snakes were directly shattered into iron sand.

This attack caused a huge commotion. Further away, a huge rift valley appeared on the ground, as if the planet had opened its mouth.

Boom!

The shockwave hit the metal sphere trapping Gadeli. The next moment, the sphere was shattered into pieces. Gadeli hurriedly broke free, his face covered in dust.

Han Xiao was shocked. Jayne's destructive power had shocked him. Her nickname of 'Seaquake' was true to her name. Any Esper who could reach Grade A was not weak. It should be known that if one's Esper potential did not reach Grade A, their individual strength would definitely not reach Grade A.

Boom boom boom!

Shana and Jayne completely unleashed their firepower. The battlefield kept shifting, and the area within hundreds of kilometers became a mess. Countless caves collapsed, and giant snakes slithered. It was like a disaster. Han Xiao and Gadeli watched from the side.

However, although the commotion was shocking, Shana was hovering in the air. The earthquake did not affect her at all. She had the absolute upper hand.

Glancing at Han Xiao, who was dodging everywhere, a look of disdain flashed across Shana's eyes. She shook her head.

Although Black Star was the target on the list, his presence was almost non-existent. His performance was far worse than Jayne's. Instead, Jayne was more qualified to be the target.

Shana was a little disappointed. Rumors had it that Black Star was very powerful. She felt that he was just so-so. He did not live up to his name.

Thinking about it, she countered Black Star. It was normal that Black Star did not have the ability to fight back.

"If not for these two reinforcements, it would not be so troublesome."

Shana frowned. As long as she took care of Jayne and Gadeli, Black Star would be a piece of cake.

However, she had a new idea. Jayne was very powerful and would become a member of the list sooner or later. She might as well capture Black Star and Jayne here and now.

As for that Gunner, she felt that he was just so-so. There was no value in capturing him.

Just then, a gap appeared in Jayne's defense. Shana grabbed the opportunity and wrapped Jayne with a giant metal snake, turning him into a sphere. Jayne kept shaking inside, trying to break the cage. However, Shana focused most of her energy on him. She controlled dozens of giant metal snakes to stack on top of the sphere.

The giant sphere kept shrinking, and its density kept increasing. Its ability to resist earthquakes skyrocketed. The shaking inside became smaller and smaller. Jayne could not struggle anymore.

Done! Shana's eyes lit up. She had Jayne under control. From her point of view, the battle was over. Black Star had lost his powerful reinforcements and could be captured easily.

Shana turned around and stared at Han Xiao through the dust in the air. She said calmly, "Your reinforcements are gone. Now, it's your turn."

Han Xiao suddenly stopped and looked at Shana from afar.

Just when Shana thought that Han Xiao had given up resisting, Han Xiao suddenly laughed.

"You're right. It's my turn."

Buzz —

The next second, a continuous roar came from the sky!

Shana looked up.

Fifty "stars" fell from above her head at an unbelievable speed.

These "stars" were all the Eye of God's railguns. Each beam had a diameter of about seven to eight meters!

Shana's pupils contracted.

She only had time to form a magnetic field shield. The next moment, fifty satellite energy beams fell!

Boom!

A deafening explosion swept across the area!

The incessant shockwaves from the strong winds blew everything around them away. Gadeli was sent flying far away, while the giant metal ball that was enveloping Jayne shot through the air and embedded itself deeply into a mountain more than ten kilometers away.

A dazzling mushroom cloud of flames rose into the sky. Their vision was completely white, and they could not see anything.

Countless rocks turned into Ashes, and the giant metal snake melted into molten iron.

This scene was like the end of the world!

Even in outer space, they could see a blazing red mushroom rising from the planet's surface!

Han Xiao looked like he was slacking, but in fact, he was commanding Risda, who had left the battle, to place fifty Eye of God space-based satellite cannons in the warehouse in outer space. One round of orbital bombardment was enough to destroy an entire city!

The enemy had displayed powerful control skills. He could only tank, but it would be difficult to defeat the enemy. Only powerful firepower could determine victory.

Han Xiao put his hands on his hips and chuckled.
